INC-2024-1847.title: Production API Gateway timeout errors
INC-2024-1847.description: Multiple timeout errors reported on Core Banking API gateway. Users experiencing 504 Gateway Timeout when accessing account balance and transaction history endpoints. Error rate spiked from 0.1% to 12.4% starting at 08:00 UTC.

summary.rootCause: Under investigation — suspected deployment v2.4.1 regression
summary.businessImpact: ~2,400 users unable to access account services
summary.workaround: Failover to secondary region partially mitigating impact

timeline.author: Sarah Chen
timeline.action: Investigating API gateway logs. Seeing connection pool exhaustion on upstream services.

timeline.author: AI Assistant
timeline.action: Root cause analysis: Deployment v2.4.1 introduced increased connection timeout. Rollback recommended.

timeline.author: Marcus Johnson
timeline.action: Confirmed v2.4.1 deployed at 07:45 UTC. Correlates with error spike timeline.

logs.message: upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while connecting to upstream
502 Bad Gateway — upstream service unavailable: core-banking-svc:8080
Deployment v2.4.1 health check: DEGRADED (2/5 pods ready)
Rate limit bypass triggered for /api/v2/accounts/* — 847 req/min
Removing unhealthy instance core-banking-svc-7f8b9c from pool

aiAnalysis.summary: Analysis indicates deployment v2.4.1 as the likely root cause. Connection pool configuration change reduced max connections from 500 to 200, causing exhaustion under peak load.
findings: Error spike correlates within 30 minutes of v2.4.1 deployment
Connection pool exhaustion pattern matches previous INC-2024-1720
Secondary region operating normally on v2.4.0 — confirms regression hypothesis
recommendedActions: Rollback deployment to v2.4.0 in primary region
Scale connection pool to 400 as interim measure
Enable circuit breaker for upstream health checks

suggestedFixes.title: Rollback to v2.4.0
suggestedFixes.description: Revert Core Banking API deployment to last known stable version.

suggestedFixes.title: Increase connection pool size
suggestedFixes.description: Update HikariCP maxPoolSize from 200 to 400 in production config.

suggestedFixes.title: Enable regional failover
suggestedFixes.description: Route 100% traffic to secondary region until primary is stable.

comments.author: Sarah Chen
comments.content: Started investigation. Initial logs point to upstream connection issues on core-banking-svc.

comments.author: Marcus Johnson
comments.content: Confirmed v2.4.1 deployment timeline. Approving rollback if AI analysis confidence holds above 90%.

comments.content: Auto-remediation runbook RB-0042 is available. Rollback can be executed with one-click approval.

INC-2024-1846.title: Database connection pool exhaustion
INC-2024-1846.description: Customer Portal database connection pool at 98% capacity causing slow page loads.

summary.businessImpact: Customer portal response times degraded to 8-12 seconds
summary.workaround: Read replica routing enabled for reporting queries

logs.message: Timeout waiting for connection from pool after 30000ms

aiAnalysis.summary: Long-running analytics queries are holding connections. Recommend query timeout enforcement and read replica offload.
findings: Pool size unchanged since last month
